recognize_zh: 這是 G 顯帶核型圖而非形態學影像：性染色體區有 2 條 X 加 1 條 Y（X 對被圈起），其餘體染色體各 2 條，總數 47 條，即男性病人的 +X 數目異常（47,XY,+X）。
features: G-banded karyogram with 22 pairs of structurally normal-appearing autosomes
Two X chromosomes (circled) plus one Y chromosome, giving 47 chromosomes
No structural rearrangement or marker chromosome in this metaphase
Banding resolution is moderate; subtle structural changes cannot be excluded
describe_en: This figure is a G-banded karyogram rather than a morphologic image. It shows 47 chromosomes with two X chromosomes (circled) and one Y chromosome, and no apparent structural abnormality of the autosomes. In a male patient, this represents a numerical gain of chromosome X, reported as 47,XY,+X in the analyzed metaphases. Because a constitutional 47,XXY (Klinefelter) karyotype produces an identical picture, a PHA-stimulated peripheral blood or remission sample is needed to confirm that the gain is acquired and leukemia-specific in this B-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: A constitutional gain is present in all tissues including PHA-stimulated lymphocytes and remission marrow, whereas an acquired +X is restricted to the leukemic clone.
High hyperdiploidy has 51-67 chromosomes with gains of X, 4, 6, 10, 14, 17, 18, and 21, not an isolated single gain.
Doubled hypodiploid clones show paired losses and uniparental disomy patterns across many chromosomes, not a single extra X.
